reserves_and_recruitment.note: Force and torque norms are kept separate. Biological joint rows are also described by their recorded muscle capacity; pelvis support is not counted as joint reserve recruitment.
reserves_and_recruitment.legacy_recruitment_norm_note: Recorded tau_*_norm and unactuated_reserve_norm can combine translation force and rotation torque; they are reported as legacy diagnostics, not a uniform Nm quantity.

equilibrium_failure_interpretation.meaning: Per-step count of muscle equilibrium attempts for which _safe_compute_equilibrium returned False during minimum-activation baseline preparation and maximum-activation muscle-matrix probing. It is not a final SO solver failure flag.
equilibrium_failure_interpretation.handled_fallback: If computeEquilibrium throws or returns an invalid fiber length, the helper sets that muscle's fiber length to optimalFiberLength and returns False. During a failed maximum-activation probe, high_force is replaced by baseline_force, so that muscle's force gain and matrix column become zero. This is a handled fallback, not evidence that equilibrium was subsequently recovered.
equilibrium_failure_interpretation.application_note: The captured override_actuation mode directly applies baseline_force plus the optimized linearized increment; the additional final-activation equilibrium branch is not used in this rollout.
equilibrium_failure_interpretation.limits: The scalar output does not identify the muscle or separate baseline failures from maximum-activation probe failures. Repeated counts over neighboring timesteps are not distinct affected muscles. A completed rollout and a small SO residual do not establish exact physiological equilibrium for the affected attempts.

visual_review.subject: AB06
visual_review.scope: Rendering, source labelling and visual legibility only; no biomechanical qualification

01_time_sea_control_reserve.png.review: Reviewed: subject, IK-driven HS alignment, requested/physical nine seconds and runtime status are explicit. Effective cascade/plugin gains, SEA torques, normalized controls and zero prosthetic reserves are legible.

02_time_joint_motor_states.png.review: Reviewed: actual joint/motor positions and velocities remain distinct, with startup and later transients visible. Knee flexion sign matches canonical plots; axes and legends are readable.

03_gaitcycle_torque_angle_power.png.review: Reviewed: torque-angle and power plots use the three frozen measured-GRF primary cycles for both actual and subject healthy data. Means and standard deviation bands are legible; this is reference phase rather than a manufactured actor-FSM cycle count.

04_gaitcycle_joint_velocity_power.png.review: Reviewed: actual/healthy angles, velocities and joint/motor powers are normalized on the same three primary reference cycles. Phase labels and subject healthy overlays are explicit.

05_time_tau_input_tracking_error.png.review: Reviewed: native motor torque and separate spring/input torque errors retain startup and later peaks; all channels, units, legends and the effective controller gains are legible.

06_time_joint_ref_sea_error.png.review: Reviewed: recorded served IK-driven reference, actual joint motion and actual-minus-served errors are explicitly distinguished in radians. No raw/filtered IK fallback replaces missing served data.

07_prescribed_healthy_ik_actual.png.review: Reviewed: subject healthy remap, raw prosthetic-model IK and actual motion are separated for prosthetic left and biological right in degrees. Actual-minus-raw-IK and raw-IK-minus-healthy-left differences are explicit; this raw-IK diagnostic remains distinct from the served-reference tracking in figure06.
